title: tc-fingerprint-card
description:
A ten-print card: each finger's print and status – captured with its NFIQ quality, poor, not captured, unable to
print or bandaged – the count on file, and a finger's detail on Enter or click.

heading.description: The heading, and the grid's name

prints.description: The prints by finger position; a finger not listed is not captured

selected.description: The finger whose detail is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

statusLabels.description: The statuses' names, merged over the defaults (Captured, Poor quality, Not captured, Unable to print, Bandaged)

locale.description: The language for dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

pattern.description: The ridge pattern, drawn on the tile and named in the detail; whorl when not given

captured.description: When it was captured, epoch ms

image.description: The print's image URL, shown instead of the drawn pattern

note.description: One line about the finger, e.g. "Bandaged on 12 May – recapture booked"

FingerPosition.description: ANSI/NIST finger positions: 1–5 right thumb to little, 6–10 left thumb to little

FingerStatus.description: captured: a usable print · poor: on file but low quality · missing: not captured yet · unable: can't be printed (amputated, scarred) · bandaged: temporarily can't be printed
